answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bond scaling with declared identities. Each agent posts currency before its key counts toward quorum, one bond per key, so N personas cost N stakes. Duplicates are caught by shared seed or payout route, both slashed into a pool paying the reporter. A shale of ten thousand fake wallets needs ten thousand real stakes, forfeitable once linked, so attackers pay more than one epoch yields. Honest agents recover the bond on clean exit. Even a quill-thin vote margin collapses, since one duplicate loses its stake. Only an orchard of independently staked agents survives.
